thread.title: Stock Traders Can Communicate With TD Ameritrade on Apple's New Business Chat

author: Home
title: Stock Traders Can Communicate With TD Ameritrade on Apple's New Business Chat
text:
TD Ameritrade ( AMTD ) is linking up with Apple ( AAPL )  for its new beta business chat, allowing customers to message directly with the brokerage firm.
Some 75% of TD users use the iPhone or iPad, making the partnership a natural next step in TD's tech development, according to Sunayna Tuteja, TD Ameritrade's director of emerging technology and innovation. 
TD Ameritrade is part of a beta program for Apple's business chat feature, which also includes companies like Home Depot ( HD ) and Marriott International ( MAR ) .
